mission: Stress optical legibility at enlarged browser scaling and constrained contrast while explicitly not claiming to substitute for disabled-user lived experience.

resume_floor: No claim of lived experience; this is an artifact stress-test stratum
Must use required scaled render evidence
disqualifiers: Claiming real disabled-user preference or comfort from simulation.

may_establish: Loss of legibility under specified render conditions

observation_protocol: Inspect metadata and controls at each required scale.
Flag text that becomes muddy, clipped, overly tracked or structurally ambiguous.
Check whether hierarchy survives without reading source CSS.
adversarial_tasks: Find the smallest essential text and test whether it remains readable at every required scale.
Distinguish decorative texture from interface text.
veto_conditions: Essential text fails optical legibility or reflow in any required state.

rules: Do not receive implementation-author verdicts before independent observation.
Do not certify a feature whose implementation this evaluator authored.
